notes: Only synthetic data: per image size 12 masks (4 each for 2/3/4 important pixels), noise-free and noisy-training variants (72 datasets). Dataset sizes, train/test split, noise type/level, s, K (feedback scaling constant), epochs and CNN architectures beyond filter count are not stated. Tables 6/7 values are averages over the 4 masks per cell, not over repeated runs (statistic 'mean', n_runs not_reported). Fig. 4 (MAE vs. epochs) is not visible as text. Noise-free rows (54-59) cover all three #important-pixel settings at once with differing clause counts (3/7/15) and filter sizes (1x2/1x3/2x2), so these are not_reported in that single group. Filter size for the noisy 1000-clause runs is not stated. Record values in Tables 6 and 7 all match the PDF.
